content.text: A wiki that grows needs order. This page shows what keeps it tidy, and you can try each part on it.
Every page has an owner, shown beside the date at the top. Open Details to hand a page to someone else. The word next to it is its status, which you can change from the same line.
The labels at the bottom of this page group it with others, across spaces. Follow one to see all its pages, or type a new one.
Choose From a template under Create. This space has a template of its own, called Team update, which asks a question before the page starts.
Blog in the sidebar lists the news of this space, outside the tree. The Team handbook in the tree is a folder: it has no text of its own, and groups the pages below it.
